{{Quote|I want those clone troopers punished, as a reminder to all of them that for the rest of their abbreviated lives they would do well to understand whom they truly serve. It is time that you were revealed as my authority. I leave it to you to drive the point home."''<br>''"And the surviving Jedi, Master?"''<br>''"The escaped Jedi&hellip; yes. You may kill any you come across during the course of your mission.|Darth Sidious sends his new apprentice, Darth Vader, to Murkhana.|<ref name="DL" />}}
Two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led a '''mission''' to deal with traitorous [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] who had facilitated the escape of their former [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]]s, rather than comply with [[Order 66]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] whom Vader pursued, [[Roan Shryne]] and [[Olee Starstone]], were able to evade the Sith Lord and escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="DL" />

==Prelude==
{{Quote|What was the cause of the troopers' insubordination, Master?"''<br>''"Contagion. Contagion brought about by fighting alongside the ''Jedi'' for so many years. Clone or otherwise, there is only so much a being can be programmed to do. Sooner or later even a lowly trooper will become the sum of his experiences.|Darths Vader and Sidious|<ref name="DL" />}}
{{Expandsect}}

==The mission==
===Vader's arrival===
{{Quote|So much the better that one of you survived. The commandos saved your life, and now you hope to save theirs, is that it?"''<br>''"My only intent is to take you out of the hunt."''<br/>''"You won't be the first Jedi I've killed.|Vader and Bol Chatok, right before their duel to the death|<ref name="DL" />}}
{{Expandsect}}

===The hunt and escape===
{{Quote|Shouldn't be hard to equip you with false identities and outwit the local garrison troopers."''<br>''"Normally, I'd agree. But someone new has been added to the mix. A Lord Vader. A sort of black-armored version of Grievous, only more dangerous, and apparently in charge of doing Palpatine's dirty work."''<br>''"Really. I haven't heard anything about him."<br>"You will. And he could present a problem to our getting off this rock.|Cash Garrulan and Roan Shyne|<ref name="DL" />}}
{{Expandsect}}

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|So, my young apprentice, two Jedi slip through your grasp and you scatter the blame like leaves blown about by the wind.|Sidious hears Vader's frustrations.|<ref name="DL" />}}
{{Expandsect}}
